scripts.build: npm run build -w @anweba/glugent-core && npm run build -w glugent && npm run build -w glugent-vscode
scripts.test: npm run build -w @anweba/glugent-core && npm run build -w glugent && npm test -w @anweba/glugent-core -w glugent -w glugent-vscode
scripts.release:maintenance: npm run build && changeset publish --tag maintenance
scripts.docs:build: node packages/cli/bin/glugent.js build readme contributing package-cli package-core package-schemas license package-cli-license package-core-license package-schemas-license package-vscode-license -c glugent.config.json
scripts.docs:check: node packages/cli/bin/glugent.js build readme contributing package-cli package-core package-schemas license package-cli-license package-core-license package-schemas-license package-vscode-license --check -c glugent.config.json
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run docs:check && npm run examples:check
